Yasenove Druhe Jewish cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Yasenove Druhe, Ukraine

Not demolished. Marked on a 1927 Russian topographic map, which shows it once occupying a larger plot extending into the neighboring Christian cemetery to the west, this cemetery remained in use until at least 1960. Little is known of the local Jewish community (Yasynove); population reached 573 (13%) by 1897 and 610 by 1926. Nazi occupation from August 1941 saw nearly 150 Jews murdered that autumn. Epigraphic data confirms Jewish presence in Yasenove Druhe continued at least into the 1960s.
